justification: Both surfaces depict a highly schematic anthropomorph and include a round disc motif, and both use simple curving incised/painted lines, but these are near-universal motifs. A shows a small stick figure with raised arms beside a long horizontal wavy serpent line on an open rock surface, whereas B is a monumental frontal human bust whose body carries clustered relief motifs (ring, bands, paired ovals) organised over the figure itself — different subject, composition and depictive conventions.
